summary: Standards/spec fidelity: `--report junit:a.xml --report junit:a.xml` (the same path twice) writes two identical entries in ci.reports and cases_run() adds both: a report of 3 passed + 1 failed counts 8 (probed live, exit 0, data.reports[] lists it twice). The brief says reports is one line per report file and min_cases is the only guard against a partial run, so one 60-case run given twice reads as 120 and clears `min_cases: 100`. The bound files are already deduplicated (add_unique_file in bind_all_scenarios) but `batch.reports = reports.iter().map(ParsedReport::count)` is not. No test passes a path twice (evidence.ci-run.02 uses two distinct files). A copy of the file under another name still counts twice; ci is a claim, so that part is the documented limit, but the accidental repeat is not. Fix: one entry per distinct resolved report file, or refuse a repeated --report, with a case in evidence.ci-run.02 and gate.ci-run.05. Blast radius: data.reports[] of every batch and the counts printed per report.
